services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Nestled along the pristine shores of Delavan Lake, Lake Lawn Resort stands as a beacon of recreational excellence in Wisconsin. Located near the Lake Geneva area, Lake Lawn Resort offers a diverse array of watersports activities and boat rentals, ensuring that every guest can experience the thrill and serenity of the water. We offer a full lineup of rentals including speedboats, tritoons, paddleboards, kayaks, waverunners and a paddleboat. We also rent out watersports equipment and toys from the Lakefront Landing watersport building, daily! All motorized rentals are subject to a 10% fuel surcharge at time of payment as well as $30 mandatory insurance fee
